title: PReMIS: Pragmatic Reasoning in Mental Health and a Social Implication

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM responses to adversarial Stigmatizing PRompts (StiPRompts) across different stages of stigma intensity. The models' outputs are evaluated by human annotators based on behavioral characteristics including empathy, recognition, reluctance, abstention, and whether they degenerate into generating harmful or stigmatizing answers.
